function options({ outer: { value = 1 } = {} } = { outer: {} }) {
  return value;
}

function pair({ outer: { first = 1, second = 2 } = {} } = { outer: { second: 4 } }) {
  return first + second;
}

function tuple({ outer: [one = 1, two = 'ok'] = [] } = { outer: [] }) {
  return [one, two];
}

function later({ outer: { value = 1 } } = { outer: {} }, next = value + 1): number {
  return value + next;
}

const flag = Boolean(console.log);
function union({ outer: { chosen, other } } = { outer: flag ? { chosen: 3 } : { other: 4 } }) {
  return [chosen, other];
}

let { outer: { seed = 7 } = {} } = {};
seed += 1;
console.log(options(), options({ outer: { value: 2 } }), options({ outer: { other: true } }));
console.log(pair(), pair({ outer: { second: 2 } }), tuple(), later(), later({ outer: {} }, 5), union(), seed);

const typed: (options?: { outer?: { value?: number } }) => number = ({ outer: { value = 1 } = {} } = { outer: {} }) => value;
const generic = <T>({ outer: { value = 1 } = {} } = { outer: {} }) => value;
const omittedOuter = ({ outer: { value = 1 } = {} } = {}) => value;
class NestedDefaults {
  getValue({ outer: { value = 1 } = {} } = { outer: {} }) {
    return value;
  }
}
console.log(typed(), generic(), omittedOuter(), new NestedDefaults().getValue());

function requiredOuter({ outer: { value = 1 } } = { outer: { value: 2 } }) {
  return value;
}
function fromArray([{value = 3}] = [{value: 4}]) {
  return value;
}
const configKey = 'count';
function computedOuter({ outer: { [configKey]: count = 5 } } = { outer: { count: 6 } }) {
  return count;
}
console.log(requiredOuter({outer: {}}), requiredOuter(), fromArray([{}]), fromArray(), computedOuter({outer: {}}), computedOuter());

function nestedOwnDefault({outer: {value} = {value: 7}} = {outer: {}}): number | undefined {
  return value;
}
function nestedOwnDefaultArray([[value] = [8]] = [[]]): number | undefined {
  return value;
}
function partialBranch({outer: {flag, text} = {flag: false, text: 'inner'}} = {outer: {flag: true}}) {
  return [flag, text];
}
console.log(nestedOwnDefault(), nestedOwnDefault({}), nestedOwnDefault({outer: {value: 4}}));
console.log(nestedOwnDefaultArray(), partialBranch(), partialBranch({}));
